hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -20 ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/sim/*) if grep -nE "from ['\"]three|document\.|window\." "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERREUR: src/sim/ ne doit importer ni three ni le DOM (PLAN.md §4.2)'; exit 2; fi ;; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *"npm run dev"*|*"vite preview"*|*"npm run preview"*) if [ "$(jq -r '.tool_input.run_in_background // false')" != "true" ]; then echo 'Lance les serveurs avec run_in_background: true (CLAUDE.md)'; exit 2; fi ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'Rappel : modifications non commitées.'; fi
